about: The paper book's pre-registration (scripts/paper_book.py). Registered 2026-10-21, the commit date. Paper only, DraftKings through ESPN. Changing a rule (anything but its note) restarts that rule's clock; a new rule gets its own registered date.

entry.note: a rule looks once: the first snapshot with DraftKings' line and our model's number, within 6 hours of the first line seen

stake.note: stake = kelly x cal x EV / (decimal - 1) x bankroll; EV at the close expected from k x gap; caps in % of bankroll; a 25% drawdown halves stakes
